wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap ruin node 6758627778 and Northern Territory Heritage Place 12939 locate the fort. The 75 by 50 yard enclosure follows the printed report. The archaeological survey confirms an approximately 80 by 60 m extent including its projections.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the historic log enclosure, dry ditch, paired roofs and coast-side sheds.
limitations: The 1824 structures no longer stand. The date, anchor and approximate orientation mark a historic reconstruction on current terrain.
Roof pitch, gate appearance, building pad heights and the exact position of the two lower sheds are estimates from the contemporary engraving and written record.
